title: The checks cut is accepted
situation: All 15 visible examples pass; the assayer rejected once on two findings (a package audit only CI ran, an undeclared dependency), both fixed, then accepted; CI ran the one check green. The ledger now reads all six integrated cuts as integrated, with no record changed.
decision: Accepted. Rulings on the lead's hardening notes: (1) an integrated cut has no ready work packages; integration is terminal (0149), and the reading that still lists them is a defect, future work. (2) The leftover comments describing a live judging lane behind a switch, and the guard's exemption of that switch, go: no switch may let a model-calling test into the check (0154); future work, first. (3) The ledger check that needs a recorded integration in the repository's own ledger, and the delivery-journal test that uses a design example as its fixture, should carry their own fixtures; future work. (4) A judgment file of an integrated cut that no longer runs is history, left as it is.
consequences: Integrated into dev. Future work in order: the live-lane leftovers, the integrated cut's ready packages, self-contained fixtures; then the workflow-delivery cut.
